items: 1 egg yolk (save the white for later)

steps.title: Make the crust
steps.body: Mix together **2 cups flour**, **1 tsp baking powder**, **1 cup sugar**, **3 tsp cinnamon**, **½ cup butter**, softened, **½ cup shortening**, **1 egg** and **1 egg yolk**. Press into a 10×15 pan.

steps.title: Brush with egg white
steps.body: Brush with **1 egg white** (from before), whisked.

steps.title: Add the topping
steps.body: Combine **⅓ cup sugar**, **1 tsp cinnamon**, **½ cup nuts** and **6 oz chocolate chips**, and sprinkle on top.

steps.title: Bake and cut
steps.body: Bake at 350°F for 25 minutes (better crispy than soft), and cut into triangles.
